say:7:1623461006:1.text: H-hey, you tore up your books?!

say:8:1623461007:1.text: What else am I supposed to do? Can't you see it? Our whole lives are nothing but spells, selection, competition. That's all this place cares about!
say:8:1623461007:1.source_cn: 不然呢？你还没看明白吗？我们的生活里除了魔法、选拔、竞...

say:9:1623461008:1.text: If we fall behind even a little, the school treats us like we're nothing!
say:9:1623461008:1.source_cn: 要是魔法退步了，在学校眼里我们就一文不值！

say:10:1623461009:1.text: But... we're magic students. Studying spells is what we're here to do...
say:10:1623461009:1.source_cn: 可我们是魔法学生……认真学习魔法本就是我们的责任……

say:11:1623461010:1.text: So what? Who gave the school the right to decide what we're worth?
say:11:1623461010:1.source_cn: 学生又怎样？谁给了学校定义我们价值的权利？

say:12:1623461011:1.text: I'm not just tearing up my own books. I'm going to make more people see what this school really is!
say:12:1623461011:1.source_cn: 我不光要毁了自己的魔法书，还要让更多人都看清学校的真面目！
